notes.title: Patch Notes April 27th
notes.content:
- Added the ability for the player to click on an enemy to view its stats

- Stats panel is reactive and shows the enemies health and speed.

This should give players a better feel for how their towers stack up against their enemies.

notes.title: Patch Notes April 26th
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where the boss bombs would spawn inside your towers occasionally making them unclickable to defuse.

- Did a hotfix to the difficulty of mobs to make it easier to succeed.  A hard mode with the current mob stats will be added at a later date.

Hope you all enjoy!

Upcoming Change

- Mouseover health bar for enemies giving me information about their Speed, Heal etc.

notes.title: Patch Notes April 25th
notes.content:
-Fixed an issue with some models not animating correctly.

-Fixed an issue with the materials being incorrect on some models.
